title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Kapitan Ramon National High School in Barangay Kapitan Ramon City of Silay Province of Negros Occidental to Don Felix T. Lacson Memorial, National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Kapitan Ramon National High School in Barangay Kapitan Ramon City of Silay Province of Negros Occidental to Don Felix T. Lacson Memorial, National High School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9641_2009.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Renaming of a National High School. - The name of Kapitan Ramon National High School in Barangay Kapitan Ramon, City of Silay, Province of Negros Occidental is hereby changed to Don Felix T. Lacson Memorial National High School.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the official Gazette.
